# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| communications-brief | `assets/comms-brief.md`, filled | Internal Communications | Objective, audiences, one message, two to four proof points each with source, evidence class and wording status, an audience variant per audience, a call to action with a role as contact, channels and timing (open points until IC states them),… |
| check-output | Output of `scripts/check_comms_brief.py` | Internal Communications | Exit 0, or only explained warnings; No blocker |
| approvals-list | Approvals section of the brief | Plant owner, OD lead, Internal Communications | Roles named in order (plant owner, OD lead, Internal Communications) with their real status; None marked given by an agent |
| draft-assets-optional | Article, one-pager, slide or short post | Internal Communications | Each draft repeats the proof points and adds no new claim |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| communications-brief | `python scripts/check_comms_brief.py {file}` | Internal Communications |
| check-output | manual | Internal Communications |
| approvals-list | manual | Plant owner |
| draft-assets-optional | manual | Internal Communications |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `comms-showcase`
- **Next:** Internal Communications reviews and publishes (step 43); then comms-followup (step 44), with the approved brief.: `comms-followup`
- **Next:** The call to action points plants to catalog-usecase.: `catalog-usecase`
- **Stops here when:** the check reports a blocker (for example a proof point without source or evidence class, a saving worded as a result without a registered project, a named individual or an internal host or link)
- **Stops here when:** The brief does not leave OD until fixed
- **Stops here when:** A human hands the brief over
- **Stops here when:** the agent never publishes
